question: Northgate Fuel reported card skimming at its pumps from 12 November 2026. Which customers may have had their card details taken?

start.sql: select * from merchants where name like '%northgate%'
start.note: merchants: select * from merchants where name like '%northgate%'

hops.note: transactions: join transactions on transactions.merchant_id = merchants.id
accounts: join accounts on accounts.id = transactions.account_id
customers: join customers on customers.id = accounts.customer_id

planted: Card payments at Northgate Fuel on or after 12 Nov: C08 (12th), C21 (13th), C33 (15th). Before: C02 (6th), C14 (9th).
